title: Product of cube monomials
statement: For any finite list $S_1,\ldots,S_k$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and any sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, the product of the associated cube monomials equals the monomial indexed by the symmetric difference of all the sets: $\prod_{j=1}^k\prod_{i\in S_j}x_i=\prod_{i\in S_1\triangle\cdots\triangle S_k}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: the list consists of finite subsets of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
